$comment: Default lens pack. Each lens is one typed question Jev answers about every decision, all in one request per decision. label, label_ko and hint are UI-only. A lens with `check` has an answer code can compute, so its agreement rate is shown as a calibration check.

lenses.label: Market regime
lenses.hint: What was the market doing when he acted?
lenses.instructions: Which description best fits the market in `market_before` at the moment of the trade?

criteria.uptrend: A steady climb over days and weeks without a violent spike.
criteria.downtrend: A steady decline over days and weeks without a violent crash.
criteria.range: Sideways: no clear direction over the past week, ordinary volume.
criteria.selloff: A sharp, fast drop in the last hours or day, often on heavy volume.
criteria.squeeze: A sharp, fast rise in the last hours or day, often on heavy volume.

lenses.label: Against the 24h move
lenses.hint: Bought after a fall, or sold after a rise
lenses.instructions: The trade in `action` goes against the 24-hour price move in `market_before.last_24_hours`: it bought after Bitcoin fell, or sold after Bitcoin rose.

criteria.true: Bought after a fall, or sold after a rise.
criteria.false: Bought after a rise, sold after a fall, or the market was roughly flat.

lenses.label: Grows the position
lenses.hint: Opened, added, or flipped into something bigger
lenses.instructions: Judging only from `action.effect_on_contracts`, the trade leaves his open contract position larger than it was before the trade. Ignore Bitcoin exposure.

criteria.true: He opened a new position, added to it, or flipped into a bigger position on the other side.
criteria.false: He reduced or closed his position, or flipped into a smaller position on the other side.

lenses.label: Panic selling
lenses.hint: Sharp fall on unusually heavy volume
lenses.instructions: At the moment of the trade, `market_before` shows panic selling: a sharp fall on unusually heavy volume.

criteria.true: A sharp recent fall together with heavy or very heavy volume.
criteria.false: No sharp recent fall, or the fall happened on normal or light volume.

lenses.label: Buying frenzy
lenses.hint: Sharp rise on unusually heavy volume
lenses.instructions: At the moment of the trade, `market_before` shows a buying frenzy: a sharp rise on unusually heavy volume.

criteria.true: A sharp recent rise together with heavy or very heavy volume.
criteria.false: No sharp recent rise, or the rise happened on normal or light volume.

lenses.label: Catching a falling knife
lenses.hint: Buying while the drop is still under way
lenses.instructions: The trade in `action` buys into a fall that is still under way: Bitcoin is falling over the last 6 hours and the last 24 hours, and he is buying.

criteria.true: He bought while both the last 6 hours and the last 24 hours show Bitcoin falling.
criteria.false: He sold, or Bitcoin was not falling over both windows.

lenses.label: Right after a loss
lenses.hint: Account equity just took a hit
lenses.instructions: The trade comes right after a painful stretch for his account, as described in `account_before`: his equity fell clearly over the previous 24 hours or 7 days.

criteria.true: His account equity fell, fell sharply, or is well below its 30-day peak.
criteria.false: His account equity was flat or rising, and near its 30-day peak.

lenses.label: Boldness
lenses.hint: Size and risk of the trade given the market
lenses.instructions: How bold is the trade in `action`, given the market in `market_before` and the account in `account_before`?
criteria: Cautious: a small, passive trade that reduces risk.
Measured: an ordinary-sized trade placed patiently.
Assertive: a larger trade, or one that adds risk.
Bold: a large trade that adds risk against a strong move.
Very bold: a very large, fast trade into a violent market.
